name: Seihuo
source:
An ice spirit who stumbled into Solvalis while on a journey to find his way home. Having grown weak after staying in unsuitable environments for so long, he's forced to stay with Anholly. Though reluctant at first to accept her help, he grows attached to her when he senses how sincere of a person she is.

As an elemental spirit of nature, Seihuo is mostly content with himself and his situation, no matter how dire it is. He chooses to be alone of his own accord, unlike Anholly who has no other choice.

Despite how dry and uncaring he may seem, he sympathizes with Anholly and her struggles to find inner peace.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12659545.seihuo]official bio[/url]]
